1.text: Tha word of tha LORD which came 2 Zephaniah tha son of Cushi, tha son of Gedaliah, tha son of Amariah, tha son of Hizkiah, in tha days of Josiah tha son of Amon, king of Judah.
I will utterly consume all things from off tha land, says tha LORD.
I will consume man N beast; I will consume tha fowls of tha heaven, N tha fishes of tha sea, N tha stumblingblocks wit tha wicked; N I will cut off man from off tha land, says tha LORD.
I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, N upon all tha inhabitants of Jerusalem; N I will cut off tha remnant of Baal from dis place, N tha name of tha Chemarims wit tha priests;
N ’em dat worship tha host of heaven upon tha housetops; N ’em dat worship N dat swear by tha LORD, N dat swear by Malcham;
N ’em dat r turned back from tha LORD; N dose dat have not sought tha LORD, nor enquired 4 him.
Hold ur peace at tha presence of tha Lord GOD: 4 tha day of tha LORD is at hand: 4 tha LORD has prepared a sacrifice, he has bid his guests.
N it will happen in tha day of tha LORD’s sacrifice, dat I will punish tha princes, N tha king’s children, N all such as r clothed wit strange clothing.
In tha same day also will I punish all dose dat leap on tha threshold, which fill their masters’ houses wit violence N deceit.
N it will happen in dat day, says tha LORD, dat there shall be tha noise of a cry from tha fish gate, N an howling from tha second, N a great crashing from tha hills.
Howl, y’all inhabitants of Maktesh, 4 all tha merchant people r cut down; all dey dat bear silver r cut off.
N it will happen at dat time, dat I will search Jerusalem wit candles, N punish tha men dat r settled on their lees: dat say in their heart, tha LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
Therefore their goods shall become a booty, N their houses a desolation: dey shall also build houses, but not inhabit ’em; N dey shall plant vineyards, but not drink tha wine of it.
Tha great day of tha LORD is near, it is near, N hurries greatly, even tha voice of tha day of tha LORD: tha mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
Dat day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble N distress, a day of wasteness N desolation, a day of darkness N gloominess, a day of clouds N thick darkness,
A day of tha trumpet N alarm against tha fenced citiez, N against tha high towers.
N I will bring distress upon men, dat dey shall walk like blind men, because dey have sinned against tha LORD: N their blood shall be poured out as dust, N their flesh as tha dung.

Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able 2 deliver ’em in tha day of tha LORD’s wrath; but tha whole land shall be devoured by tha fire of his jealousy: 4 he shall make even a speedy riddance of all ’em dat live in tha land.

2.text: Gather y’all together, yeah, gather together, O nation not desired;
Before tha decree bring forth, before tha day pass as tha chaff, before tha fierce anger of tha LORD come upon u, before tha day of tha LORD’s anger come upon u.
Seek y’all tha LORD, all y’all meek of tha earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be y’all shall be hid in tha day of tha LORD’s anger.
4 Gaza shall be forsaken, N Ashkelon a desolation: dey shall drive out Ashdod at tha noon day, N Ekron shall be rooted up.

Woe 2 tha inhabitants of tha sea coast, tha nation of tha Cherethites! tha word of tha LORD is against u; O Canaan, tha land of tha Philistines, I will even destroy u, dat there shall be no inhabitant.
N tha sea coast shall be dwellings N cottages 4 shepherds, N folds 4 flocks.

N tha coast shall be 4 tha remnant of tha house of Judah; dey shall feed thereupon: in tha houses of Ashkelon shall dey lie down in tha evening: 4 tha LORD their God shall visit ’em, N turn away their captivity.: or, when, etc
I have heard tha reproach of Moab, N tha revilings of tha children of Ammon, whereby dey have reproached my people, N magnified themselves against their border.

Therefore as I live, says tha LORD of hosts, tha God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, N tha children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even tha breeding of nettles, N saltpits, N a perpetual desolation: tha residue of my people shall spoil ’em, N tha remnant of my people shall possess ’em.
Dis shall dey have 4 their pride, because dey have reproached N magnified themselves against tha people of tha LORD of hosts.
Tha LORD will be terrible 2 ’em: 4 he will famish all tha gods of tha earth; N men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all tha isles of tha heathen.
y’all Ethiopians also, y’all shall be killed by my sword.
N he will stretch out his hand against tha north, N destroy Assyria; N will make Nineveh a desolation, N dry like a wilderness.

N flocks shall lie down in tha midst of her, all tha beasts of tha nations: both tha cormorant N tha bittern shall lodge in tha upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in tha windows; desolation shall be in tha thresholds: 4 he shall uncover tha cedar work.

Dis is tha rejoicin city dat lived carelessly, dat said in her heart, I am, N there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place 4 beasts 2 lie down in! every one dat passes by her shall hiss, N wag his hand.

3.text: Woe 2 her dat is filthy N polluted, 2 tha oppressing city!
She obeyed not tha voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in tha LORD; she drew not near 2 her God.
Her princes within her r roaring lions; her judges r evening wolves; dey gnaw not tha bones till tha morrow.
Her prophets r light N treacherous persons: her priests have polluted tha sanctuary, dey have done violence 2 tha law.
Tha just LORD is in tha midst of it; he will not do iniquity: every morning does he bring his judgment 2 light, he fails not; but tha unjust knows no shame.
I have cut off tha nations: their towers r desolate; I made their streets waste, dat none passes by: their citiez r destroyed, so dat there is no man, dat there is none inhabitant.
I said, Surely u will fear me, u will receive instruction; so their livin should not be cut off, howsoever I punished ’em: but dey rose early, N corrupted all their doings.

Therefore wait y’all upon me, says tha LORD, until tha day dat I rise up 2 tha prey: 4 my determination is 2 gather tha nations, dat I may assemble tha kingdoms, 2 pour upon ’em mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: 4 all tha earth shall be devoured wit tha fire of my jealousy.
4 then will I turn 2 tha people a pure language, dat dey may all call upon tha name of tha LORD, 2 serve him wit one consent.
From beyond tha rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even tha daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

In dat day will u not be ashamed 4 all ur doings, in which u have transgressed against me: 4 then I will take away out of tha midst of u ’em dat rejoice in ur pride, N u will no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
I will also leave in tha midst of u an afflicted N poor people, N dey shall trust in tha name of tha LORD.
Tha remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: 4 dey shall feed N lie down, N none shall make ’em afraid.
Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad N rejoice wit all tha heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
Tha LORD has taken away ur judgments, he has cast out thine opp: tha king of Israel, even tha LORD, is in tha midst of u: u will not see evil any more.
In dat day it shall be said 2 Jerusalem, Fear u not: N 2 Zion, don’t let thine hands be slack.
Tha LORD ur God in tha midst of u is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over u wit joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over u wit singin.
I will gather ’em dat r sorrowful 4 tha solemn assembly, who r of u, 2 whom tha reproach of it was a burden.
Look, at dat time I will undo all dat afflict u: N I will save her dat halteth, N gather her dat was driven out; N I will get ’em praise N fame in every land where dey have been put 2 shame.
At dat time will I bring u again, even in tha time dat I gather u: 4 I will make u a name N a praise among all people of tha earth, when I turn back ur captivity before ur eyes, says tha LORD.
